free_tier.stated: Withdrawn. The company states: 'Effective August 1, 2026, DeGirum has ceased operations. Its assets have been acquired by LatticeWork... AI Hub is being discontinued in full, including the Pro tier. Pro users get a free grace period of Pro access through September 30, 2026, after which AI Hub will no longer be available publicly. Cloud Compiler is being sunset on September 30, 2026.' The discontinued free plan was '20k AI Hub inferences per month, 1 included user, and 1 local device license', which was the only free cloud lane for running models on several edge accelerators without owning the hardware.

chaining: It was the free half of a chain with Hailo's and other vendors' compilers, which produce hardware-specific binaries that the caller cannot execute without the silicon. That chain is now broken at the execution step.
